import statistics
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs')

source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    rows = sorted(r for r, c in points)
    median_row = (rows[(len(rows) - 1) // 2] + rows[len(rows) // 2]) // 2
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    for c in range(left, right + 1):
        if out[median_row][c] == 0:
            out[median_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        for rr in range(min(r, median_row), max(r, median_row) + 1):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
